en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside building in a rural or small-town setting. The two-story house has many windows and signage along the facade indicating it houses a restaurant, bakery, and materials store. Bare trees and a simple fence line the riverbank in the foreground, with several people standing on the path and near the entrance. The style and clothing of the figures suggest an early 20th‑century European village scene. The lower margin of the card bears printed captions, including the place name and the publisher's details.
